sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Barcelona-based H3O architects has renovated a 19th-century house in the city's Gracia neighbourhood, taking care to preserve heritage elements while introducing quirky details like hidden windows. Casa Plató is a formerly rural house that was transformed into a grand residence by the ancestors of its current owner, who added a tower, galleries, mouldings and balustrades The post H3O uses "playful and intelligent gestures" to update historic Barcelona home appeared first on Dezeen .
